## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Verification

- [ ] Unsigned generic iOS build succeeds.
- [ ] Relevant behavior was tested on a physical device, or the reason it was not is documented below.
- [ ] Camera, microphone, Photos, BLE, and network behavior remain consistent with `PRIVACY.md`, or that document was updated.
- [ ] Motor-control changes were tested conservatively with an accessible cutoff.
- [ ] Model changes include provenance, license, conversion details, checksums, and limitations.

## Test environment

List the Xcode version, device, iOS version, detection backend, and controller/firmware revision where relevant.

## Remaining risks or limitations

Describe anything reviewers should verify or monitor.
